reviews.review_text: The bungee style looked like it would feel more flexible -- the brand new chair seat is a bit firm and inflexible. Also, its way too early to tell if the aluminum will stand up to normal use... Also, 'cup holder and 'pocket' that comes with the chair is tiny -- too small for a regular 12oz can, lame, and looks like it cost 20 cents to make.... but the chair was cheap enough so its all ok so far...

reviews.title: Nice chair, but not functional.
reviews.review_text: The chair is well made and given our age, my wife wanted something higher, which would be easier to get up from. I wanted an aluminium frame, which it has. However, the pouch on the side of the chair is so small, that a water bottle will not even fit, let alone a can of pop or beer. Pretty much limits its use on the beach. Would have kept it otherwise.
The chair is lightweight and easy to use but after a few uses at the beach it started rusting.
The phone pouch and bottle holder are too small to hold anything. They are hanging on the bottom rail of the chair with velcro straps.
